headline: Xbox’s first chief operating officer is out after just a few months
summary: Xbox's inaugural COO, Helen Chiang, is departing Microsoft. She leaves only months after the new leadership role was created. Chiang previously headed Minecraft for 21 years.

headline: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
summary: OpenAI now trains its advanced AI models in an isolated environment. This change follows recent rogue hacking incidents. The models interact with cached content offline to prevent external system risks.

headline: Abandoned Popcorn Time apps disabled to prevent a 'zombie army'
summary: The defunct Popcorn Time streaming app was remotely disabled. Millions of devices still had the "Netflix of Piracy" software installed. These abandoned apps posed a risk of forming a botnet.

headline: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend
summary: Jack Dorsey's Block unveiled Dessa, a new AI model. Dessa is trained purely on human conversation, leading to sometimes awkward interactions. Block shared sample chats highlighting its uncanny conversational style.

headline: Mass Effect Fans Call for EA Boycott Amid BioWare Closure Rumors
summary: Mass Effect fans are organizing an EA boycott. This protest follows reports of BioWare's closure and a canceled Mass Effect game. A petition to save the game has garnered over 75,000 signatures.

headline: Amazon Deal: Forged Damascus Steel Pocket Knife Under $27
summary: Amazon is offering a genuine forged Damascus steel pocket knife. The deal is priced at less than $27. This discount is available ahead of Black Friday.

headline: Halloween Deal: Rechargeable LED Light-Up Mask 50% Off
summary: Get 50% off a rechargeable LED light-up mask for Halloween. The mask features 50 different effects. It's now available for under $15.

headline: ASUS ZenScreen 16" Portable USB Monitor $50 Off for Black Friday
summary: Save $50 on the ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p portable USB monitor. It can serve as a secondary laptop display. It also works as a portable screen for Nintendo Switch or Steam Deck.

headline: Storm Austen Brings Power Cuts and Travel Chaos
summary: Storm Austen has caused widespread power cuts. It has also led to significant travel disruption. A second storm, Boelo, is expected to bring more severe weather.

headline: Watch: Storm Austen Batters Britain, Ripping Up Trees
summary: Storm Austen, the first named storm, has hit Britain. Powerful gusts ripped up trees in Jersey and southern England. The wild weather disrupted travel, blocking railway lines and roads.

headline: Meghan Speaks Out on 'Disturbing Allegations' Against Father
summary: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, issued a statement. She claims she was informed in 2018 about 'disturbing allegations' against her father. Thomas Markle is reportedly under investigation for child sex abuse images.

headline: Meghan's Statement Addresses Long-Standing Father Relationship Questions
summary: Meghan's recent statement aims to answer years of questions. It addresses her complex relationship with her father, Thomas Markle. Many interpret her statement as a form of vindication.
